children: This is the wave structure subpage for Bathroom Approach. It contains its every past wave layout.
names indicates an enemy type's debut.
Well, so much for an easy mission.
Forget about the fragment. Hold this position and defend against these...ducks.
The Bread Givers are trying to stop us, KEEP ATTACKING!
There doesn't seem to be that many ducks, but I'm not sure. Waiting for more intel.
We found a few of these makeshift rabbit turrets lying around. I think you could make use of them.
They strapped a bomb to a duck!
Don't you think that's pretty extreme?!
We need to attack them from a different angle. SEND IN AERIAL REINFORCEMENTS!
Flying Ducks inbound! Redirect some firepower above us!
The team is looking into what happened with their portal. So far, it seems they relied on it for food. Maybe if we fixed it, the ducks can settle down.
YOU WILL END BECAUSE I DEMAND IT.

Ducks that are trained with guns?
I don't know why the portal was disconnected, but this nerdy duck has formed an army against us.
I need EVERY available duck ATTACKING THEM!
Be careful with their operator ducks. There's something about them that I don't trust.
Our final preparations are complete. It's time I handled this myself!
SYSTEMS UP AND RUNNING. ELIMINATION, GUARANTEED.
So that's where he used the shard! It's over, duck!
Although, why do I feel we've done this before?
